items.title: Tech stocks rally to kick off August. Can chipmakers keep up with demand?
items.summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) surge ahead to close out the first trading day of August with daily gains, the Nasdaq Composite rising by 2.13%. Cboe senior vice president JJ Kinahan joins Josh Lipton to assess the day's rise in the tech sector as key chipmakers like AMD (AMD) prepare to release earnings this week. Kinahan is also Cboe's head of retail expansion and alternative investment products.

items.title: AMD vs. Sandisk: Which company will get some post-earnings market love?
items.summary: AMD (AMD) and Sandisk (SNDK) are both set to report quarterly earnings this week. Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry, Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré, and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma discuss how markets could react to both earnings reports.
